item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J03040","case1_error":"Adds three inches of growth to the 66-inch baseline probability, although final height is only two inches above that baseline.","case2_error":"Treats four basil plants as the total herb count, then subtracts mint plants absent from that subtotal, omitting parsley.","reason":"The first uses growth instead of height above the baseline; the second confuses a category subtotal with the whole inventory.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03041","case1_error":"Adds costs for 14 individual balloons and two complete packs, purchasing 34 balloons instead of the required 14.","case2_error":"Treats two extra red pencils as the entire red-pencil count in each special pack, omitting its original red pencil.","reason":"The first combines redundant purchases; the second mistakes an additional quantity for a total quantity.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03042","case1_error":"Charges for only one of two sandwiches and evaluates the displayed sum as $30.25 instead of $32.25.","case2_error":"Provides unsupported final answer 150 after correct formulas, which yield 180 checkout shoppers.","reason":"The first contains a missing quantity multiplier and explicit sum evaluation error; the second supplies an incorrect number without showing its evaluation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03043","case1_error":"Subtracts four from the post-addition fish count instead of relating the catch to the original count.","case2_error":"Appends unsupported numerical answers ending in 34000 after correct formulas that yield 4680 gallons.","reason":"The first establishes an incorrect relation using the final state; the second gives unsupported numbers after a correct mathematical setup.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03044","case1_error":"Subtracts car expenses from the console price, treating spending as progress toward the purchase and ignoring available savings.","case2_error":"Assigns all 60 remaining cupcakes to each flavor, doubling the required remainder instead of dividing it between them.","reason":"The first incorrectly relates expenses to the savings shortfall; the second duplicates a total across its two parts.","judgment":"different"}]}
